items.source_locator: StatPearls Borderline Personality Disorder, defense mechanisms/DSM-5-TR criteria: splitting and alternating idealization/devaluation.

items.source_locator: DailyMed Insulin Glargine prescribing information, Dosage and Administration: do not dilute or mix with any other insulin or solution.
AHRQ PSNet PCA opioid respiratory-depression case analysis: PCA-by-proxy bypasses the patient's sedation-based safety feature; sedation/respiratory assessment is required.
items.source_version: AHRQ PSNet authoritative safety analysis reviewed 2026-08-15

items.source_locator: ONS/ASCO Guideline for Management of Antineoplastic Extravasation, 2025, Vol 29(5):384-399; immediate response algorithm: stop infusion, leave access in place for aspiration, then agent-specific management.
items.finding: Source upgraded from news summary to exact ONS/ASCO guideline.

items.source_locator: DailyMed Ondansetron labeling, Warnings and Precautions: QT prolongation/torsades reported; avoid in congenital long-QT syndrome.
MedlinePlus Taking iron supplements: black/dark stools are common with oral iron; tarry-appearing stool or concerning bleeding features require medical review.
DailyMed Allopurinol labeling: if a gout flare occurs during treatment, allopurinol need not be discontinued; manage the flare concurrently.
DailyMed Alendronate Sodium administration instructions: after arising, 6-8 oz plain water, before food/other medication, remain upright at least 30 minutes.
DailyMed Phenelzine labeling, hypertensive-crisis dietary warning: aged cheeses and cured/fermented high-tyramine foods must be avoided.
DailyMed Flumazenil Injection indications/warnings: reverses benzodiazepine sedation; seizure risk in high-risk/dependent patients and resedation require monitoring.
DailyMed Nitroglycerin Sublingual Tablets, Adverse Reactions/Warnings: headache and dizziness/lightheadedness are recognized nitrate effects; hypotension may occur.

Surviving Sepsis Campaign 2026 adult guideline: sepsis/septic shock treatment begins immediately; cultures ASAP ideally before antimicrobials; measure lactate; septic-shock antimicrobials immediately, ideally within 1 hour.
items.finding: Currentness/source locator upgraded to the 2026 guideline.

items.source_locator: Joint Commission Universal Protocol FAQ: discrepancies must be resolved before the procedure; final time-out verifies correct patient, procedure, and site with the immediate procedure team.
items.source_version: Joint Commission FAQ last updated 2026-01-09; reviewed 2026-08-15

items.source_locator: Joint Commission National Performance Goal for medication management: maintain accurate medication information at transitions, compare medication history with orders, and resolve discrepancies.
items.source_version: Current Joint Commission National Performance Goal reviewed 2026-08-15

items.source_locator: Joint Commission Patient Identification FAQ: use at least two person-specific identifiers; room number or physical location is not an acceptable identifier.
ISMP/ECRI look-alike/sound-alike risk-reduction guidance: separate storage where appropriate, Tall Man/name differentiation, barcode verification, and other system defenses rather than memory alone.
items.finding: Source upgraded to exact system-level LASA mitigation guidance; FDA Name Differentiation Project separately confirms hydrALAZINE/hydrOXYzine Tall Man pair.

items.source_locator: AACN Practice Alert, Managing Alarms in Acute Care Across the Life Span: individualize clinically appropriate alarm settings, reduce nonactionable alarms, and maintain reliable response to actionable alarms.
items.source_version: Current AACN Practice Alert listing reviewed 2026-08-15
items.finding: Source upgraded from generic FDA human-factors page to an alarm-specific professional practice alert.

items.source_locator: CDC Environmental Cleaning Procedures, terminal/discharge cleaning: clean/disinfect patient-care area and reprocess reusable noncritical equipment before the next patient.
29 CFR 1910.134(f): tight-fitting respirator fit testing before initial use, with different facepiece, and at least annually; additional testing after fit-affecting physical changes.
HHS REMM START adult triage algorithm: if an apneic adult remains without spontaneous breathing after airway repositioning, categorize black/expectant/deceased under START.
items.source_version: Current HHS REMM START algorithm reviewed 2026-08-15

items.source_locator: HHS HIPAA Breach Notification Rule: impermissible disclosure of unsecured PHI is presumed a breach unless low probability of compromise is demonstrated by required risk assessment; mitigation/notification follow as applicable.
HHS HIPAA FAQ 2065 and 45 CFR 164.524: a provider may not deny a patient's access to records because the patient has not paid for services.
items.source_version: Current HHS HIPAA access FAQ reviewed 2026-08-15
items.finding: Source upgraded from broad access guidance to exact unpaid-bill FAQ.
